Name: Additional Shop Item
Author: KanDa312
Description:
Hello, this mod add additional items to Willy, Robin, and Clint shop. 

[b]New item in 1.0.6:[/b]
Clint Shop: Add 3 craftable.

[b]New item in 1.0.5:
[/b]Marlon Shop: Add All Vanilla Bachelors and Bachelorettes Weapon.

[b]New item in 1.0.4:[/b]
Clint Shop: Add Cinder Shard and Battery Pack.

[b]New item in 1.0.3:[/b]
Marnie Shop: Add Animal Products (Egg, Large Egg, Brown Egg, Large Brown Egg, Milk, Large Milk, Goat Milk, Large Goat Milk, Wool).

[b]New item in 1.0.2:[/b]
Robin Shop: Add common Tree Seed and its tapped product (Mahogany Seed, Acorn, Maple Seed, Pine Cone, Maple Syrup, Oak Resin, Pine Tar).
Marlon Shop: Add Monster Loot (Bug Meat, Slime, Bat Wing, Solar Essence, Void Essence).
Pierre Shop: Add Fertilizer (Hyper Speed-Gro, Deluxe Fertilizer, Deluxe Retaining Soil).
Clint Shop: Add Ore and Geode (Radioactive Ore, Geode, Frozen Geode, Magma Geode, Omni Geode). 

[b]New item in 1.0.1:[/b]
Willy Shop: Wild Bait, Magic Bait, Deluxe Bait, Challenge Bait, Cave Jelly, River Jelly, Sea Jelly.
Robin Shop: Clay, Hardwood, Moss, Fiber.
Clint Shop: Iridium Ore, Solar Essence, Void Essence (Change Solar and Void Essence to Marlon Shop in 1.0.2).

Tell me what do you think about the price? Is it too cheap? Or too expensive? Let me know.
If you want any other items, please post your comment and i will try to add them. 

[b]How to install this mod:[/b]
1. Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
2. Download and extract to "Mods" folder [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
3. Download and extract to "Mods" folder [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (Optional)
4. Extract this mod to "Mods" folder.
